title: La Pedrera and Sagrada Família
text: Giovanna was great! So much interesting info! There is a good amount of walking, including stairs, and a 20 minute walk to Sagrada Família.
author: Road726098

title: Amazing tour
text:
I only had a few hours to explore Barcelona while at a meeting and this seemed like a great tour to see Sagrada Família along w another sight efficiently and in depth in a short time.
We had a small group of 7 and Xavier was an outstanding tour guide. Because it was a small group, we were able to ask lots of questions and move around easily. Casa Mila was really unique and the cava was a nice break to sit and chat (the restaurant was right next door and was formerly the store area for the residents of Casa Mila so has the interesting Gaudi ceilings). title: Nice evening tour with Naiara
text:
We wanted to definitely visit Sagrada Familia for our (my brother and I) visit to Barcelona. What we did not realize that the bookings had to be done far in advance, and we had not done so. Fortunately, we found a trip option for Casa Mila + Sagrada Familia along with cava tasting. This turned out to be a better experience than we could have had on our own, thanks to our guide Naiara and the nice group we went with.

title: Gaudi experience with Xavier
text: Xavier was an amazing tour guide . Very informative but also very informal, funny antedates and kept the tour light and moved along at a good speed
author: nwil2n

title: Jewels of the city and great guided tour
text: Sagrada Familia a must, La Pedrera Gaudí impressive and a great closure with a glass of cava and some great local tastings.
author: 849kevinm

title: Great Sagrada Familia and La Pedrera experience
text: This tour accomplished some things on my bucket list. WWOOOOWWW La Sagrada Familia and Gaudi!!! It is a nice late afternoon tour combo with La Pedrera. The guide did a great job driving us through the neighborhood and we had a good chat at the end with a glass of cava and the tapas. I highly recommend the tour.
author: Carobcn73

title: Great tour for Sagrada Familia.
text:
Amazing tour through the most beautiful church I have ever seen. The light, the architecture, Gaudi was a genius. We then had a nice 20-minute walk through the modernism neighborhood. Juli, the guide, explained the other modernist buildings all the way to La Pedrera. I loved la Pedrera. It is like being in a unique residential building and the terrace is iconic.
